create_transition_class: create a BaseTransition subclass with get_target_state, validate_transition, and transition methods
test_transition_validation: test a transition with Pydantic Field validation including required fields, patterns, and range constraints
register_state_transition: register a transition class using the register_state_transition decorator with entity name and transition name
test_transition_context: test TransitionContext with entity, current_user, current_state, target_state, reason, and context_data fields
run_get_available_transitions: run get_available_transitions to retrieve registered transitions for an entity with optional validation
